project.title: Eukaryotic Targeted Metagenomes of Wastewater Sludge, Produce Wash Water, and Produce Irrigation Water in Southeastern U.S.
project.description: Amplicon metagenomes of environmental samples, including wastewater sludge, produce wash water, and produce irrigation water collected from growing regions in the southeastern United States.
